title: Admission Procedure & Steps
answer:
Here is the admission procedure as published on the RVPU Harohalli website:

📝 **Admission Procedure at RVPU Harohalli**:

1. Application forms obtainable post-SSLC result announcement.
2. Submission of application with passport photographs & 10th marksheet.
3. Document verification and merit-based counseling.
4. Admission finalized on first-come, first-served basis per merit list.

*Note*: Application forms can be obtained post-SSLC result announcement. Admissions proceed on merit and first-come, first-served counseling.

title: Required Documents for Admission
answer:
Here are the required documents for admission verification as listed on the RVPU Harohalli website:

📄 **Documents Required for Admission at RVPU Harohalli**:

• SSLC / 10th standard original marks card + photocopies
• Aadhaar card (photocopy)
• Transfer Certificate (TC) from previous school/institution
• Conduct Certificate from previous school/institution
• Provisional Eligibility Certificate (issued by Department of Pre-University Education for non-Karnataka / international candidates)
• Caste Certificate (for SC/ST/BCM candidates)
• Income Certificate (if annual family income is below ₹44,500)
• Passport size photographs

*Note*: Candidates must bring the original certificates along with attested photocopies for verification during counseling.

title: Eligibility & Admission Criteria
answer:
Here is the admission eligibility criteria as stated on the RVPU Harohalli website:

🎯 **Eligibility & Admission Criteria**:

• **Qualifying Examination**: Candidates who have successfully passed the Karnataka SSLC / ICSE / CBSE / 10th Standard or any equivalent examination recognized by the Department of Pre-University Education (DPUE), Karnataka.
• **Admission Basis**: Admissions are conducted on merit basis following the declaration of Class 10 results. Candidates submit the application with marks card and documents for counseling verification.

📊 **Examination & Promotion Rules**:
• **I PUC**: District-level examination conducted under Karnataka DPUE (Min. 30% per subject, 35% aggregate to pass).
• **II PUC**: State-level Board Examination conducted by Karnataka DPUE.
